entries.title: Your first mate's answers are its own cards
entries.body: When your first mate answers a question about a task, its card now reads first mate instead of showing that task's name and details as if the task had written it. It names the tasks it is about in its words, and each of those tasks links to the answer from its record. Buttons on a choice about a task still act on that task.
